description: The Xiox window: the app's own commands, its view events, the zoom of its own webview (Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0: engine zoom and browser keys are off) and, for the title bar of the Smooth look, which the page draws: dragging, its double click, minimize, maximize and close, and whether the window is maximized. No shell, filesystem, HTTP or dialog permissions for the page: folder and save dialogs open from Rust.
